test_main: test the main function to run semantic segmentation model inference and evaluation
test_parse_args: test the parse_args function to parse command line arguments for model testing
run_test_eval: run the test script to evaluate a segmentation model with mIoU metrics on a dataset
run_test_aug: run the test script with augmentation flags for multi-scale flip testing
run_test_distributed: run the test script in distributed mode using slurm launcher for multi-gpu evaluation
